The '''''Eclipse''''' was a [[Action IV transport|Action IV]] [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was used to support the Empire's Ando Project, ferrying [[Andoan mineral-fish]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uridia]].<ref name="Ando" />
